title: Private data and server source are publicly downloadable
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Public build now contains only allowlisted assets in dist/. Node serves that directory; Pages middleware also rejects private paths for legacy configurations. Both preview servers return 404 for private data/source requests.

title: Node settings API discloses the admin password
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Both settings APIs and authenticated sync use an explicit public-field allowlist. The stored/default admin password was removed from tracked settings and client defaults.

title: Stored cross-site scripting in the admin lead table
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Lead-table text and attribute values are escaped. Harmless stored HTML markers were submitted and displayed as text without executing on both backends.

title: Returning to Home can leave the site completely covered
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Cross-page links use native browser navigation. Home → About → Home completes without duplicate declarations or a stuck overlay; fragment scrolling and browser history retain browser behavior.

title: Fixed menus, navigation and floating actions use the full document as their viewport
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: The retained transform was removed from body animation. Reduced-motion disables the page animation. Menus scroll within the viewport on short screens; fixed navigation stays at viewport top after scrolling.

title: Portfolio links fail when opened directly or refreshed in fallback mode
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: The shared case-study route renders fallback portfolio projects when OneDrive is not configured. Actual card URLs now return 200 on both servers.

title: Node server does not implement published article or portfolio detail routes
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Node now invokes the same article and case-study renderers as Pages, with a safe local public-asset adapter.

title: Arabic pages lose their language and right-to-left direction
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Language metadata derives from the route. All six existing Arabic pages retain lang=ar, dir=rtl and their Arabic navigation URLs.

title: Arabic toggle leaves major English content untranslated
status: Behavior changed to supported translations
resolution: Partial word-by-word translation was removed. Language links open the existing complete Arabic counterparts; unsupported English pages explicitly link to the Arabic services overview. This does not add translations for every specialized English page.

title: Contact form stores malformed UAE phone numbers
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Phone numbers use shared libphonenumber parsing on the client and server. National trunk prefixes, international pastes and invalid numbers are covered by tests; the UAE local number test stores +971501234567.

title: Pricing quote links do not scroll to the target form
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Native navigation follows #free-audit after opening Contact, with scroll padding for the fixed header. Package text still prefills correctly.

title: Server-rendered blog articles throw a JavaScript exception
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Article code updates document.title without querying the removed title ID. The template no longer displays raw query parameters in a debug panel. Article SSR no longer removes content through the obsolete debug-panel replacement.

title: Text and CTA contrast fails across the site
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Yellow buttons now use dark text; active links, metadata, footer text, testimonials and dark/light contextual labels were corrected. All 58 main-page accessibility scans and the supplementary article, case-study, 404 and admin-login scans report no automated violations.

title: Country-code selector has no accessible name
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: The country calling-code selector has an accessible name, and contact field errors are associated with their inputs.

title: Legal-page mobile menus do not manage keyboard focus or close on Escape
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Privacy Policy and Terms use the shared accessible menu implementation, with focus entry, keyboard containment, Escape and focus restoration.

title: Portfolio client view lacks dialog semantics and focus management
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Portfolio client/media views have dialog semantics, background inertness and keyboard containment. Focus enters after the opening frame and returns to the card; modal images use root-resolved URLs.

title: Privacy-policy contact links have undersized, crowded touch targets
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Privacy-policy contact links have larger hit areas and spacing. The original target-size findings no longer occur.

title: Custom-software FAQ heading overflows at 320 pixels
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Long headings wrap within narrow text columns; the custom-software page fits 320 pixels.

title: Social-media hero overflows at 320 pixels
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: The social-media hero reflows at 320 pixels. No document-width overflow was measured across the final 319 checks.

title: Node lead endpoint accepts completely empty submissions
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Node validates required lead fields on the server and rejects an empty body with 400, matching Pages.

title: Backend accepts leads without the contact consent required by the UI
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Both backends require contactConsent === true and generate the consent timestamp server-side.

title: Free-audit form accepts unusable website/Instagram values
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Free-audit submissions validate full HTTP(S) website URLs or supported Instagram handles on both the client and server. A placeholder such as x is rejected.

title: Some dynamic 404 responses have empty bodies
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Dynamic error pages fetch assets with a clean GET, follow same-origin canonical asset redirects, and always return a readable 404 body.

title: Node 404 responses display the homepage
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Unknown Node routes return the existing 404 template rather than homepage markup.

title: Node favicon endpoint is missing
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Node serves the favicon asset successfully.

title: Work-page contact number differs from the rest of the site
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: The portfolio footer now uses the primary site number, +971 56 539 0316.

title: Cloudflare admin password-change UI can report success without changing the login password
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: The misleading password-change form was replaced with explicit deployment-managed password instructions. All authentication reads ADMIN_PASSWORD; settings cannot silently override it.

title: Mutable scripts and styles are cached as immutable for one year
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Mutable assets use revalidation headers. Updated CSS/JS references carry ?v=20261108 to bypass prior immutable browser entries on the first fixed release.

title: Known default admin password remains enabled when no override is configured
status: Code fixed; deployment configuration required
resolution: No working default credentials remain. Admin login returns 503 until a 16+ character ADMIN_PASSWORD and 32+ character SESSION_SECRET are configured.

title: Session signing falls back to known source-code values
status: Code fixed; deployment configuration required
resolution: Pages signing requires the configured SESSION_SECRET. Node uses the configured secret, or an unpredictable ephemeral secret while admin access is disabled for missing configuration.

title: Cloudflare API reflects arbitrary credentialed CORS origins
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Pages no longer reflects arbitrary credentialed origins; unknown origins are rejected with 403 and no access-control grant. Node rejects cross-origin POSTs as well.

title: Dependency audit reports eight affected packages
status: Fixed in source and local verification
resolution: Runtime and development dependencies were updated. npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities, including after adding the browser-test dependencies. Node 22+ is now required by the toolchain.

title: Login and lead submission have no application-level throttling
status: Code fixed; deployment configuration required
resolution: Login, lead submission and analytics handlers enforce application-level request limits. Node limits are per process; Pages uses immediate per-isolate limits plus best-effort KV carryover. Strict global production quotas still require edge/WAF rules.
